password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password, then the new one. You stay signed in on your other devices.

notifications.title: Useful updates. Less noise.
notifications.candidate: Job alerts, application updates and new messages by email. Account and security emails are always sent.
notifications.recruiter: New applications and new messages by email. Account and security emails are always sent.

privacy.title: Choose how you’re discovered
privacy.description: Your resume isn’t shared just because your profile is visible.

discoverable.label: Profile visibility & recruiter discovery
discoverable.description: Allow recruiters to find your profile, listed skills and career preferences. Turn this off to keep your profile private. Companies you applied to still see your application.

resumeVisible.label: Resume visibility
resumeVisible.description: Allow recruiters who find your profile to open your live CV. Companies you applied to can always open the CV you sent.

matchingConsent.label: Matching consent
matchingConsent.description: Allow your profile to be used in AI matching. No protected characteristics are used.

privacy.note: Every download of your CV is logged.

layout.title: Your workspace. Your terms.
layout.description: Simple controls for your privacy, notifications, and personal information.

data.title: Understand and control your data
data.notice: This interactive prototype stores reviewed profile fields and workspace activity in this browser. Original resume files are processed locally and are not saved; version history contains file names and reviewed profile snapshots only. No real account or server-side data exists.

export.label: Download your profile
export.description: A portable CSV of your reviewed information.
export.candidateDone: Profile exported as candidate-profile.csv. The file was created in your browser and not sent anywhere.

delete.label: Delete local candidate information
delete.description: Remove your profile, saved jobs, applications, and alerts. Payment records are kept.
delete.confirmBody: This removes your profile, CV versions, verification progress, learning progress, saved jobs, applications, and alerts from this device, and your plan goes back to Free. Your settings are kept. Payment records are kept as finance records; only Reset demo clears them. This can’t be undone.
delete.done: Local candidate information was deleted from this device.

reset.label: Reset demo workspace
reset.description: Restore sample data across all three workspaces.
reset.confirmBody: This restores the sample data in the candidate, recruiter, and admin workspaces and clears the changes saved on this device. This can’t be undone.
reset.done: Demo workspace reset. Sample data is back in all three workspaces.
